research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS / DOMAIN: the domain in the brief, bankbumiarta.co.id, does not exist (NXDOMAIN at the .co.id registry on 2026-11-03). The bank's official site is https://www.bankbba.co.id (title 'Bank Bumi Arta - Teman Anda Dalam Usaha'; footer 'Copyrighted (c) 2026 P.T. Bank Bumi Arta, Tbk.'). Every document was downloaded directly from www.bankbba.co.id on 2026-11-03 (no bot protection, no archive route). The IR pages load their document lists from the site's own JSON endpoints (POST https://www.bankbba.co.id/bumiarta/Laporan/list_lapor with paramCategory 1=annual reports, 3=published reports, 4=interim FS, 5='consolidated' FS; POST .../Rups/list_lapor/id for AGMS documents) - exactly what the browser does; the resulting PDF URLs are stored in source_url. The 'Laporan Keuangan Konsolidasi' items are 1-page scans of newspaper summaries, so the full audited FS were taken from inside each year's annual report.

ENTITY / NAME / CONTROL: legal name unchanged, PT Bank Bumi Arta Tbk (no rebrand; AR2025, 9M2026 interim FS and all 2026 disclosures use it). No acquisition, change of control or recapitalisation in 2025-2026. Shareholders at 31 Dec 2024, 31 Dec 2025 and 30 Sep 2026: PT Takjub Finansial Teknologi (Ajaib group) 33.45%, PT Surya Husada Investment 29.53%, PT Dana Graha Agung 17.72%, PT Budiman Kencana Lestari 10.95%, public 8.35% (FS2025 Note 24, AR2025 PDF p. 539). Ultimate controlling shareholders: Rachmat Mulia Suryahusada (President Commissioner, died 23 Jul 2025) and Anderson Sumarli (interim FS Note 1). Ajaib entered on 17 Nov 2021 (24%) and rose to 40% on 8 Apr 2022 by buying existing shares; it did not take up its full PMHMETD II rights, hence 33.45% now.

BASIS / UNITS: the bank has no subsidiaries (one Rp10m minority investment), so its audited statements are stand-alone ('Laporan Keuangan', not 'konsolidasian'). Money figures are labelled basis 'consolidated' because they are the entity's only, complete statements; ratios are labelled 'bank_only' (bank = whole entity). All audited and interim FS are in full Rupiah (divided by 1e9, full precision kept).

RESTATEMENT (FY2020/FY2021): the FY2022 audited FS (Note 50, AR2022 PDF pp. 547-548) restated 31 Dec 2021 and 1 Jan 2021 for (a) the DSAK-IAI PSAK 24 clarification on attributing benefits to service periods, (b) a PSAK 16 revaluation-surplus correction and (c) reclassifying credit-balance overdraft (PRK) accounts from deposits to other liabilities. Following the dataset convention (BBNI), fy.2020 and fy.2021 store the figures as ORIGINALLY reported in their own audited FS (AR2020, AR2021) and the matching original ratios (AR2020/AR2021 tables = audited Dec 2020/Dec 2021 OJK published reports). Restated values: FY2021 total assets 8,664,310.2, deposits 6,262,636.7, equity 2,241,620.8, net profit 42,675.0, EPS 18.17; 1 Jan 2021 (= FY2020) total assets 7,634,251.0, deposits 5,909,764.8, equity 1,520,991.6; AR2022+ highlight tables also print a restated FY2020 profit of 35,569 and restated FY2020/FY2021 ratios. Growth 2021->2022 on deposits is therefore overstated by the Rp54.4bn PRK reclassification.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-01-01..2026-11-03: two rights issues and nothing else - PMHMETD I (ex 2021-12-10, 5:1 at Rp1,345, +462,000,000 shares) and PMHMETD II (ex 2022-11-30, 9:2 at Rp1,345, +616,000,000 shares). No split, reverse split or bonus issue since the 2006 IPO (AR2024 PDF p. 75 and AR2025 PDF p. 78 share-listing chronology list only the IPO and the two PMHMETDs; AR2025 PDF p. 14: no corporate actions in 2025). No 2026 rights issue has been announced, but the AGMS of 30 Jun 2026 approved adding capital options to the bank's Recovery Plan and authorised the Directors to execute recovery options without a prior GMS (Mata Acara Ketujuh) - re-check for a new PMHMETD. FY2019 year_end_price is NOT stored: no rights/bonus ex-date falls before 2020-12-31 (the brief's rule is not triggered); the AR closes bracketing each issue are FY2020 Rp378 / FY2021 Rp3,240 / FY2022 Rp925. AR2020 PDF p. 14 prints the Q4-2019 close (Rp336) if ever needed.

PER-SHARE BASIS: there was never a split, so share_basis is the period-end date for FY figures and the announcement date for dividends. Reported EPS: FY2020 15.17 (2,310m shares), FY2021 16.04 (original FS divided by the 2,772m year-end count although the FS calls it a weighted average), FY2022 13.79 on a weighted 2,823,333,333 shares (validation_ack), FY2023-FY2025 on 3,388m.

DIVIDENDS: final cash dividends only - FY2020 Rp4.00/share (Rp9.24bn, 26.36%, ex 26 Aug 2021) and FY2021 Rp4.25/share (Rp11.781bn, 26.50%, ex 7 Jun 2022). No interim or special dividends. No dividend out of FY2022 (AGMS 26 Jun 2023), FY2023 (AGMS 19 Jun 2024), FY2024 (AGMS 25 Jun 2025) or FY2025 (AGMS 30 Jun 2026); payout_ratio is 0 for those years with the AGMS summary as source. The equity statements agree (retained earnings move only by profit and the general reserve).

RATIOS: CAR, NPL gross/net, ROA, ROE, NIM, BOPO and CIR come from each year's own AR 'Rasio Keuangan' table, which is identical to the audited 31-Dec OJK published report (checked visually for Dec 2020-Dec 2025). LDR comes from the published reports ('Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR)'); the AR tables print the same numbers under the label 'Loan to Funding Ratio (LFR)'. CASA comes from the MD&A sentence 'Komposisi CASA ... % dari total simpanan' (not in the ratio table). Cost of credit, NPL coverage and loan-at-risk are not disclosed for any FY (null); the 2026 published-report template adds 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah (KKR)', used as interim lar. ROE is the OJK ratio (formula not printed); it is low (0.30-2.80%) because equity (incl. a Rp726bn fixed-asset revaluation surplus) is very large relative to profit - real, not a unit slip.

PROFITABILITY: FY2025 net profit fell 84.6% to Rp9.47bn (impairment charge Rp37.7bn vs a Rp7.5bn reversal in 2024; BOPO 97.75%). 9M2026 profit Rp37.4bn vs Rp17.8bn (impairment reversal, lower interest expense).

2026 EVENTS A REVIEWER MUST KNOW: (1) legal cases against directors - disclosures of 25 Jun 2026 (Hendrik Atmaja, Edwin Suryahusada), 31 Aug 2026 (authorities exercised coercive measures, 'upaya paksa', on 29 Aug 2026 re Edwin Suryahusada) and 2 Sep 2026 (proceedings also involve President Director Wikan Aryono S. and Hendrik Atmaja); Wikan Aryono S. asked to resign on 17 Jun 2026 but the EGMS of 10 Sep 2026 did not approve it; two independent commissioners resigned (15 Apr 2026). (2) Balance sheet shrank sharply in 9M2026: deposits -30.7% YTD (5,139.7 -> 3,562.9bn), loans -16.0%, total assets -18.2%, LDR 111.32%, NPL gross 5.37%, KKR 6.99%. (3) Core capital Rp3,211.6bn at 30 Sep 2026 vs the Rp3tn minimum (POJK 12/POJK.03/2020); the AGMS of 30 Jun 2026 approved an updated Recovery Plan under POJK 5/2024 with added capital options and withheld FY2025 tantieme to protect core capital. Sources: keterbukaan informasi on https://www.bankbba.co.id/bumiarta/id/keterbukaan-informasi (DOCUMENT_260709042015.pdf, DOCUMENT_260831161948.pdf, DOCUMENT_260902155509.pdf), AGMS/EGMS summaries, 9M2026 interim FS Notes 47 and 50j. Earlier: the FY2020 audit opinion was unmodified with an emphasis of matter on the shareholders' action plan to meet the minimum core capital (note on the Dec 2020 published report), resolved by the 2021-2022 rights issues.

INTERIM: 9M2026 = interim FS for the nine months to 30 Sep 2026 (authorised 30 Oct 2026; no review report included) and the OJK published report of 30 Sep 2026 (scan; ratios read from the page image).
